items.name: Annual Report Cover and Opener
items.description: An A4 annual report cover with a photograph over a deep navy field and geometric accents, followed by a year-at-a-glance opener with four headline stats and a letter from the chair.

items.name: Back Page Column
items.description: A back-page column in a double keyline frame: centred column name, title and deck, a round portrait with name and role, a single-column essay and a sign-off line.

items.name: Bi-Fold Brochure
items.description: A four-page A4 folded brochure: a photographic cover, a welcome page with lead text, pull quote and a bleeding image, a features page with three picture rows and a stat band, and a back page with booking details and contact.

items.name: Blog Journal
items.description: A 1440 px blog index: masthead with a short introduction, a featured post beside a large photograph, a three by two grid of post cards with images, dates and excerpts, a newsletter sign-up band and a footer.

items.name: Business Card
items.description: A 3.5 by 2 inch two-sided card: logo on an accent front, name, role and contact details on the back, with bleed.

items.name: Business Proposal
items.description: A three-page Letter proposal: a split navy cover with prepared-for and prepared-by blocks, an executive summary with objectives, key numbers and reasons to choose you, then scope on a timeline, a ruled pricing table with total, and a sign-off block.

items.name: Cafe Menu Board
items.description: An A3 landscape menu board for a cafe: logo, name and hours over a dark ground, three columns of drinks and bakes with prices and one-line descriptions, a tall photograph and a footer line for milks and specials.

items.name: Case Study
items.description: A two-page A4 client case study: a deep green header with headline and photograph, an at-a-glance panel and the challenge, then the approach, three result stat cards, a testimonial and a contact line.

items.name: Certificate
items.description: A US Letter landscape certificate: a triple-ruled border with corner brackets and diamonds, the institution and title, the recipient's name in large italic over a rule, a citation, two signature lines and a central seal.

items.name: Community Bulletin, Tabloid
items.description: A one-page tabloid bulletin for a neighbourhood: a big serif masthead, lead story with photo and three-column text, a what's-on calendar, neighbour of the month, notices and a contact panel.

items.name: Company Newsletter, Two Pages
items.description: A two-page internal newsletter: a navy masthead, lead story with photo and two-column text, an index, quarter-in-numbers panel and CEO quote on page one; a people feature, two briefs, a diary, new starters and a call for stories on page two.

items.name: Conference Event Page
items.description: A 1440 px event page: a dark geometric hero with headline, date, time and venue and a ticket button, an about section with four numbers, a day programme of six sessions, four speakers with round portraits, a closing ticket band and a footer.

items.name: Conference Talk, Dark
items.description: A six-slide 1920 by 1080 conference keynote on a near-black ground: a title slide with a soft glow, a numbered section opener, a large quote, an image beside a numbered list, three big results and a closing slide with contact details.

items.name: Contents, Picture Grid
items.description: A contents page: the cover story with a large picture and page number, three features with thumbnails, and six numbered departments on a three-column grid.

items.name: Cookbook Recipe Spread
items.description: An 8 by 10 inch cookbook spread: a full-bleed food photograph facing the recipe, with title, headnote, serves and timing, a ruled ingredients list, a cook's note and numbered method steps.

items.name: Cover, Bold Masthead
items.description: A newsstand cover: a full-bleed photograph under dark fades, a heavy masthead, three cover lines, the lead story and an issue, price and barcode corner.

items.name: Culture Reviews Page
items.description: A culture page of five reviews: a lead book review with cover art and verdict, four short reviews of an album, film, exhibition and play, each with details line and a round score badge.

items.name: Department, News Grid
items.description: A front-of-book department page: a condensed section name, a lead brief with picture, a numbers box, four short items, a quote panel and column rules.

items.name: Documentation Page
items.description: A 1440 px developer documentation page: top bar with search, a left navigation column, breadcrumb, title, lede and version notice, then the article as one running story with headings, lists and shaded code blocks, and a right rail with the page contents and a next-page card.

items.name: Email Newsletter
items.description: A 600 px email newsletter: preheader, logo and date, a rounded hero image, headline, intro and button, two story cards with images, a tinted recipe feature, and a dark footer with address and unsubscribe line.

items.name: Event Announcement
items.description: A 1080 by 1350 px event ad in a vintage poster style: a presenter line, a large serif title, a one-line description, a round photograph with an offset disc, and a dark band with the date, time, venue and ticket line.

items.name: Event Poster, Type-Led
items.description: An 18 by 24 inch event poster led by type: a three-line condensed headline over a red disc, the date in large figures, times, venue, a short pitch, a programme list and a footer band for the call to action.

items.name: Event Ticket
items.description: A 5.5 by 2 inch event ticket with bleed: a dark main body with logo, pass type, event name, one line of detail and date, doors and venue, then a perforated coloured stub with the holder's name, a ticket number and a barcode.

items.name: Executive One-Pager
items.description: A Letter-size executive summary on one page: masthead, headline and deck, a band of three headline stats, an overview with key findings beside a photograph and a dark recommendation panel, and a contact footer.

items.name: Exhibition Poster, Swiss
items.description: An A2 exhibition poster in the Swiss manner: a four-column information row, a red square and black circle overprinting on the grid, a heavy rule and a three-line grotesque title set flush left.

items.name: Feature Spread
items.description: A two-page feature opener: a full-bleed photograph on the left, kicker, headline, deck and byline over two justified columns on the right, continuing on three-column pages with folios.

items.name: Gift Voucher
items.description: A DL (210 by 99 mm) gift voucher with bleed: a coloured panel carrying the value as a large figure and the voucher number, beside the logo and brand, a title and one line on what it buys, To and From lines to write on, the expiry and small print.

items.name: Gig Poster
items.description: An 11 by 17 inch concert poster: a full-bleed photograph fading into a dark ground, a heavy two-line act name, support acts, date, doors and venue in three columns and an accent ticket band.

items.name: Interview Spread, Q and A
items.description: A two-page interview: a bleed portrait with the subject's name and deck on the left, a lead-in, six questions and answers and a pull quote in two columns on the right.

items.name: Invitation
items.description: A 5 by 7 inch invitation with bleed, centred inside a fine double rule: an ornament, an invitation line, a serif title, a short occasion line, then the date, time and place, dress code and reply details.

items.name: Invoice
items.description: An A4 invoice: a dark brand band with sender details, a heavy title beside an accent amount-due box, bill-to and invoice details, five line items with quantity, rate and amount on rules, totals, payment details and terms.

items.name: Landing Page
items.description: A 1440 px landing page: navigation, a split hero with headline, deck and call to action beside a large image, three feature cards, a testimonial band and a footer.

items.name: Leaderboard Banner
items.description: A 728 by 90 px leaderboard display banner: the logo, a short headline over one line of detail, and a button, on a dark field with an accent edge.

items.name: Letterhead
items.description: A US Letter letterhead: logo, studio name and line beside a cluster of colour circles, date, recipient address and subject, a letter body that runs on to a lighter continuation page, and a three-column contact footer over a tri-colour edge.

items.name: Link Ad, Landscape
items.description: A 1200 by 627 px landscape link ad for feeds and link previews: logo and brand, a kicker, a two or three line headline, one line of detail and a button on a dark panel that fades into a photograph.

items.name: Local Business Flyer
items.description: A US Letter flyer for a local service business: logo and brand, a full-width photograph with an offer badge, headline and pitch, three services with short descriptions and a dark contact band with phone, address and web.

items.name: Long Read Opener, Swiss
items.description: A type-led opening spread on a six-column Swiss grid: a huge headline over a red square and standfirst on the left, a lead paragraph, pull quote and three-column story on the right, continuing on three-column pages.

items.name: Long-form Article
items.description: A 1440 px long-read article page: masthead, kicker, large headline and deck, a wide hero photograph with caption, then the story in one readable column beside a sidebar with byline, date and a pull quote, continuing on plain column pages.

items.description: A full-page Letter magazine ad with bleed: a photograph across the top two thirds, a serif headline beside a short paragraph and call to action, then logo, brand, web address and small print along the foot.

items.name: Medium Rectangle Banner
items.description: A 300 by 250 px medium rectangle display banner: a photograph with the logo over it, then a two-line headline, one line of detail and a button on a light panel.

items.name: Mobile Banner
items.description: A 320 by 100 px large mobile banner: the logo, a two-line headline with one short line under it, and a compact button, on a bright colour field.

items.name: Nonfiction Chapter
items.description: A 7 by 10 inch nonfiction chapter: a tinted opener with chapter contents, then a main text column beside a margin column for notes, figures, pull quotes and a boxed sidebar.

items.name: Nonprofit Newsletter, Four Pages
items.description: A four-page A4 newsletter for a charity or club: a green masthead and lead story, a director's letter with impact numbers and a supporter quote, a volunteer spotlight with briefs, and a back page of events, a call to give and a mailing panel.

items.name: Novel Interior
items.description: A 6 by 9 inch trade fiction interior: a sunk chapter opener with ornament and epigraph, then facing body pages with running heads and centred folios.

items.name: Photo Essay, Four Pages
items.description: A four-page photo essay in two spreads: an opening plate with title and deck, a full-bleed plate, a panorama across the gutter with a pull quote, and a pair of plates with numbered captions.

items.name: Photo Monograph
items.description: A 10 by 8 inch landscape photo monograph: a typographic opener facing a full-bleed plate, then a three-image grid spread and a single framed plate, with numbered captions.

items.description: An 8.5 inch square children's picture book: a bright title page with a round spot illustration, a full-spread painting with short story text in soft panels, and a text-led page with spot art.

items.name: Pitch Deck
items.description: A six-slide 1920 by 1080 investor pitch: a dark title slide with photograph, the problem with two big numbers, the solution in three steps, traction with a bar chart and key figures, the team with portraits, and a dark closing ask with contact details.

items.name: Poetry Chapbook
items.description: A 5.5 by 8.5 inch poetry chapbook with generous margins: a centred title page, a contents page with right-aligned page numbers, and a verse page with hanging turnovers.

items.name: Portfolio Grid
items.description: A 1440 px studio portfolio on a strict Swiss grid: a large statement headline, studio details, an asymmetric gallery of seven projects with names and captions, a dark studio band with portrait, services and call to action, and a big email footer.

items.name: Postcard
items.description: A 6 by 4 inch two-sided postcard in a vintage style: a bordered photograph with a 'greetings from' headline and badge on the front; caption, message, stamp box and ruled address lines on the back.

items.name: Press Release
items.description: A 1440 px newsroom press release: release label and date, headline and deck, a photograph with caption, the release text in a main column broken by a spokesperson quote, and a sidebar with media contact, press kit button, key facts and the company boilerplate.

items.name: Product Catalogue Page
items.description: A US Letter catalogue page: a dark brand bar, collection title and intro, then six products in a three by two grid, each with a photograph, price tag, name and short description, over a footer for delivery and contact.

items.name: Product Page
items.description: A 1440 px product page: announcement bar and navigation, a large product photograph with thumbnails, name, deck, price, colour and size options, add to basket and stockist buttons, a feature list, a three-up craft band, a review with rating and a footer.

items.name: Quarterly Review
items.description: A six-slide 1920 by 1080 quarterly business review: a navy title slide, four headline numbers with highlights, a monthly revenue bar chart with commentary, a segment breakdown in horizontal bars, risks and priorities side by side, and a discussion slide.

items.name: Research Brief
items.description: An A4 research or policy brief: an institute masthead with issue line, title, deck and authors, a shaded abstract box over two justified columns, then a full-width figure with caption and a numbered recommendations panel.

items.name: Restaurant Menu
items.description: An A4 dinner menu: logo, name and season centred under a fine gold border, three courses of four dishes in two columns with names, descriptions and prices, a tasting-menu note and allergy small print.

items.name: Resume, Two Column
items.description: An A4 two-column resume: a tinted sidebar with round portrait, contact details, skills, education and languages beside a condensed name and role, a short profile and four experience entries with dates and summaries.

items.name: Sale Promo, Big Number
items.description: A 1080 px square sale ad built around one huge percentage: a kicker, the sale name, the discount and what it applies to, a line of detail, a shop button and the small print.

items.name: School Newsletter, Term Dates
items.description: A two-page school or parish newsletter: a centred crest masthead, the head's letter with portrait, notices and class news on page one; a dated diary for the term, house points, stars of the week, a PTA band and reminders on page two.

items.name: Social Portrait, Product
items.description: A 1080 by 1350 px portrait product ad: a large rounded product shot with a badge and logo, the product name, one line of detail, a big price, a shop button and a brand footer.

items.name: Social Square, Bold
items.description: A 1080 px square social ad: a full-bleed photograph under a dark fade, a heavy headline, one supporting line, a pill call to action and the logo.

items.name: Social Square, Minimal
items.description: A 1080 px square social ad led by type alone: a solid colour field, a very large headline on the grid, one supporting line, an outlined call to action and the logo.

items.name: Story, Three Zones
items.description: A 1080 by 1920 px story ad in three stacked zones: brand and headline on a colour band, a full-width photograph with a round sticker, and a dark band with the offer, a button and the web address, all inside the story safe area.

items.name: Studio Update, Minimal
items.description: A minimal one-page studio update: a big friendly headline beside three dots of colour, a short lead, three project cards with rounded pictures, and a footer of works in progress, favourites and contact details.

items.name: Tall Infographic
items.description: A tall 1080 by 2700 px infographic: a dark header with headline and a circular stat callout, then three numbered sections with a stacked breakdown bar, three circle stats and a grid of four tips, closing with sources.

items.name: Tri-Fold Brochure
items.description: A US Letter landscape tri-fold in two sides: a photographic cover, a contact back panel and a first-visit flap outside; about, services and booking panels with stats, images and a call to action inside.

items.name: White Paper
items.description: A Letter-size technical white paper: a dark title page with a network motif, then body pages with running header and footer, an executive summary panel, numbered section heads and two-column text.

items.name: Wide Skyscraper Banner
items.description: A 160 by 600 px wide skyscraper display banner: logo and kicker, a stacked condensed headline, a photograph, one line of detail and a button on a dark field.

items.name: Workshop Slides
items.description: A six-slide 1920 by 1080 workshop deck: a bright title slide with shapes, a timed agenda with a materials list, four numbered technique steps, an exercise with numbered instructions and a timer, a key idea on a dark panel, and a recap with three takeaways and links.

items.name: Agenda Notes
items.description: A headless command that reads the deck and writes the list of slide titles into the current slide's speaker notes, as one undo step.

items.name: Agent Switchboard
items.description: A dock panel that reads formMCP's apps and agents, switches the window's agent and filter, and offers or withdraws an app per agent with set_for.

items.name: Beat Markers
items.description: A panel that runs formcut's beat analysis on a chosen clip and marks every beat or bar, a command that opens it, and a headless command for the selected clip.

items.name: Board Tidy
items.description: A tile on the Widgets board that lists the board's tiles and resizes, moves, removes and adds them with formtray's board commands.

items.name: Dated Entry
items.description: A headless command that inserts a dated heading and a to-do at the end of the page with doc.insertMarkdown and moves the cursor into it.

items.name: Deck Outline
items.description: A panel that builds a Markdown outline from every slide's text and notes, a command that opens it, and a headless command that saves the outline through the save dialog.

items.name: Fade In Out
items.description: A headless command that keys the opacity of every selected layer to fade in and out, all in one History step.

items.name: Format Check
items.description: A headless command that reads which skill is open and runs formskills' check on it, then reports the errors and warnings.

items.name: Frame Maker
items.description: A panel to choose a frame's colour and width, a command that opens it, and a headless command that adds the last frame as shape layers in one undo step.

items.name: Group Maker
items.description: A panel that makes a group tile from the ticked apps with group.create, a command that opens it, and a headless command that groups the running apps.

items.name: Heading Map
items.description: A dock panel that reads the page's blocks, maps its headings with the words under each, and moves the cursor to one with doc.select.

items.name: Keeper
items.description: A headless command that picks, rates and labels the selected photos with three engine commands in one undo step.

items.name: Keyword Stamp
items.description: A panel of favourite keywords that adds or removes them on the selected photos, a command that opens it, and a headless command that stamps the last keyword used.

items.name: Layer List
items.description: A dock panel that lists the layers of the open picture, shows or hides each one and makes it active.

items.name: Layer Strip
items.description: A dock panel listing the composition's layers with timing, effects and masks: click to select, and add layer markers at the current time.

items.name: Lean Start
items.description: A headless command that reads the apps and sets each server's start policy to demand with set_start, as one step formMCP can undo.

items.name: Loop Selection
items.description: A headless command that reads the selection and sets the loop to the selected range or clips, as one undo step.

items.name: Lower Third
items.description: A panel that builds a shape bar and two text layers parented to it (using $N.layer results between ops), a command that opens it, and a headless command that adds the last one again.

items.name: Marker List
items.description: A dock panel listing the timeline's markers with timecodes: click to seek, rename, remove, or add one at the playhead.

items.name: Marker List
items.description: A dock panel listing the session's markers with times: add one at the playhead (in samples), rename or remove it.

items.name: Name Stamp
items.description: A headless command that reads the document and adds a text layer with its name and size, as one undo step.

items.name: Notes Desk
items.description: A dock panel listing every slide with its notes: go to a slide, rewrite its speaker notes with a raw deck op, one undo step each.

items.name: Number Pages
items.description: A headless command that runs formpdf's page_numbers change on every page after the cover, as one undoable change.

items.name: Page Words
items.description: A dock panel that reads the PDF's text, counts the words on every page and goes to a page when clicked.

items.name: Pin Running
items.description: A headless command that reads formtray's apps and pins every running one to the Stack with stack.pin, as one change.

items.name: Preset Switch
items.description: A panel that searches the preset list and puts a preset on the selected outputs with queue.setPreset, a command that opens it, and a headless command that applies the last preset again.

items.name: Profile Snapshots
items.description: A panel that saves, uses and deletes formMCP profiles for the chosen agent, a command that opens it, and a headless command that saves a dated snapshot.

items.name: Queue Board
items.description: A dock panel showing every output of the queue with its preset and status, the totals, queue Start, Pause and Stop, and an estimate for the output you click.

items.name: Rating Desk
items.description: A dock panel showing the selected photos with camera and exposure, and buttons that rate or flag the whole selection in one undo step.

items.name: Reading Time
items.description: A panel that measures the page and the selection from document.read, a command that opens it, and a headless command that writes or updates the reading time under the title.

items.name: Region Loops
items.description: A panel listing the session's regions that loops one in a click, a command that opens it, and a headless command that turns the selected range into a region.

items.name: Retry Failed
items.description: A headless command that finds failed and stopped outputs in the queue and resets them with queue.resetStatus, as one History step.

items.name: Skill Finder
items.description: A panel that runs formskills' search and opens a hit with open-skill and open-file, a command that opens it, and a headless command that downloads the open skill.

items.name: Skill Shelf
items.description: A dock panel that reads the skill library with each skill's format check, and opens a skill in the reader with open-skill.

items.name: Split Here
items.description: A headless command that splits the selected clips at the playhead and marks the cut, as one undo step.

items.name: Watermark
items.description: A panel for formpdf's watermark change with words, colour, angle, opacity and pages, a command that opens it, and a headless Mark as Draft.

items.description: A FormCut monitor that opens on a fogged proxy of a clip, lets you wipe it clear, then sweeps the grade across the frame and pushes through to the export panel.

items.name: FormDAM capture wall
items.description: A pinned wall of FormDAM captures that pulls back from one screen to the whole library.

items.name: FormDeck deckhand
items.description: Twelve slides from FormDeck's demos to throw, flip, sort into a grid and present, as you scroll.

items.name: FormDesign spreads
items.description: A FormDesign publication turned page by page: cover, letter, contents, the Make chapter, captures, facts and a back cover.

items.name: FormEncoder in three steps
items.description: Queue the media, pick a preset, press Start: how FormEncoder turns one source into several outputs.

items.name: FormFabric stories
items.description: Six stories from FormFabric, the garment design app, each on a tall card cut from the real window.

items.name: FormMCP prompt
items.description: Type a task for an agent and watch it go through FormMCP: one family list, one app started, one result returned unchanged.

items.name: FormMCP questions
items.description: Four questions about FormMCP, answered from what it does: one short list for agents, tools on demand, three clients, one command to connect.

items.name: FormPath knockout
items.description: Drag vector shapes onto an artboard, hold to subtract them from the fill, and scroll to rinse the sheet down to single-colour artwork with clean holes.

items.name: FormRef board
items.description: A FormRef board of sixteen real captures on an infinite canvas: drag pieces, zoom around the pointer, fit them all, tidy them into columns and open any one full size.

items.name: FormSkills integrations
items.description: FormSkills installs released skills into Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, for you or for one project, from the Form family's apps.

items.name: FormSurface prompt
items.description: Ask a small scripted desk to tidy up, show FormSurface captures, empty the bin or spin a turntable, and watch the pointer do it.

items.name: FormSurface swatch
items.description: Spray pigment onto a surface the way FormSurface paints a model, then shrink it into a material card and save it as a PNG.

items.name: FormTray footer
items.description: A footer in FormTray's voice: find any FormAI app by name, and the whole family listed in the groups the launcher uses.

items.name: FormTray index
items.description: An index of twelve captures of FormTray's own windows: filter them, hover a line to preview the capture, open one to read about it.

items.name: FormTxt page not found
items.description: A page-not-found screen that searches the site and prints the closest pages on a receipt you can pull down to tear.

items.name: FormVFX orbit
items.description: Twenty-eight crops of real captures fly from a spinning ring into a constellation web as you scroll; drag, hover, filter and open any frame.

items.name: FormVFX vortex
items.description: Fourteen FormVFX shots line the inside of a long tube: scroll to travel it, click one to fly it out beside its details.

items.name: FormVis tiles
items.description: A still being relit in FormVis, cut into layers that you can scatter, re-cut and scroll back into a single image.

items.name: Glyph lens
items.description: A capture read back as text on a WebGL canvas: scroll tunes the glyph grid in, the pointer opens a lens onto the picture, and the end of the scroll opens the whole shaded view.

items.name: Infinite board
items.description: A board of captures on an infinite canvas: drag pieces, pan, zoom around the pointer or pinch, fit them all, tidy them into columns and open any one full size.

items.name: Knockout artboard
items.description: Drag vector shapes onto an artboard, hold to subtract them from the fill, then scroll to rinse the sheet down to single-colour artwork with clean holes.

items.name: Noise band backdrop
items.description: A tinted fbm noise band that rises up the backdrop, leans toward the pointer, swells while you type and surges while a prompt runs.

items.name: Orbit constellation
items.description: Twenty-eight cropped captures spin on a ring, then fly into a constellation web as you scroll; drag to spin, hover to follow a thread, filter by panel and open any frame.

items.name: Page turn
items.description: A publication turned page by page in 3D, with drag, arrow keys, arrow buttons and a swipe deck on narrow screens.

items.name: Physics deck
items.description: Twelve slides land on a desk to throw, flip and shuffle, then sort into a grid and zoom into one slide as the page scrolls.

items.name: Pigment spray swatch
items.description: A pinned stage where you spray pigment onto a surface, scroll to shrink it into a material card, and save it as a PNG.

items.name: Product site
items.description: A six page product site in the formai.studio style: home, product, about, stories, support and a not found page, with a shared header and footer.

items.name: Receipt printer
items.description: A small receipt printer that prints the closest pages for a search, row by row, and lets the visitor pull the receipt down to tear it off.

items.name: Ruler slider with odometer
items.description: A ruler with a needle you slide through a numbered list of steps, writing the step to a variable, and an odometer that rolls the digits of the readouts that follow.

items.name: Scripted desktop
items.description: A small desk with icons, draggable windows, a taskbar and an assistant whose fake pointer tidies the icons, opens captures, empties the bin and spins a turntable on request.

items.name: Specks backdrop
items.description: Soft glowing specks that rise slowly through a hero backdrop, each at its own depth, drawn on a small canvas.

items.name: Starfield backdrop
items.description: A canvas backdrop of pulsing squares laid out on a grid, thickest toward both side edges and fading downward, with four faint rings behind them and a glow that swells around the pointer.

items.name: Tile cut
items.description: A picture cut into recursive tiles that slide under the pointer, re-cut on click and merge back into one image as the page scrolls.

items.name: Token prompt
items.description: A prompt field that highlights slash commands and at mentions as you type and offers an autocomplete menu for both.

items.name: Tube travel
items.description: Shots line the inside of a long 3D tube; scrolling travels along it and a click flies one shot out beside its details.
